notes.title: First Storebound Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello shoppers!
[/h2][p]Thank you to everyone who has played the demo for Storebound so far. We are looking over all of the feedback we have received to improve the game, starting with a new patch that is out right now!
[/p][h3]If you haven't already, please consider leaving a review for the Storebound demo!
[/h3][p]It really does help us out, and more importantly we are reading every review to help us improve the game. You can leave your review on the Storebound demo page here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011020/Storebound_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq"]Also, consider joining the Discord where you can meet others to play with and ask the devs your questions.[/url]

[url="https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq" style="button"]Storebound Discord[/url]

[b]Here's what we fixed in our first patch:[/b]
• Many soft-locks have been fixed. Please continue to report these so we can fix them ASAP!
• Improved clarity of objectives and guidance in the environment to improve gameplay flow.
• Scourge has been tuned to be slightly less aggressive in the last portion of the demo.
• An invite friends button has been added to the pause menu.
• Fixed the issue that made players get stuck inside their own shoulder.

[b]Currently Unresolved Issues:[/b]
• Voice Chat: We have identified problems with in-game voice chat and are working on a fix.
• There is an issue where after all party members die the game freezes, needing a restart. We are still working on a fix.

Please continue to report issues here or on our [url="https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq"]Discord[/url].

Thank you again to everyone who has played!

See you next time, shoppers.
Nikko
Community Manager[/p]

notes.title: Storebound demo live now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello shoppers![/h3][h3]The demo for Storebound is live NOW! Go play the demo here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011020/Storebound_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p]Storebound also just had brand new trailer in Indie Fan Fest. Check out the trailer!
[/p][previewyoutube="4NyMNiDCPdY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The team has been hard at work on Storebound, so we are happy to finally share the game with you with something you can play.

This demo offers a glimpse into the mall — a fragment of the story within the larger experience of the full game. Play solo, or together with up to 2 friends. Depending on how many times it takes you to venture through the mall, the demo generally has about thirty minutes to an hour of content.

[url="https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq" style="button"]Storebound Discord[/url]

[url="https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq"]If you are looking for fellow shoppers to play with, you can join the official Storebound Discord.[/url] There you can find folks to play with, report bugs, talk about the demo, and stay up to date on development.

We are going to be monitoring feedback to make improvements and target issues. Many of you are wondering when the game will launch. Currently we are still considering when to bring the game into early access, so we'll be using the response to the demo to help us make that decision. We'll be back in future updates to give you new information about when early access launch will happen!
[/p][p]See you later, shoppers.
Nikko
Community Manager[/p]
